about.titleHighlight: Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 ENGINE
paragraphs: The Discovery Sport P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200P — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was introduced with the 2019 facelift of the L550 generation and remains in production today. The AJ200P is the mid-output version of the Ingenium petrol family, sitting between the P200 and the discontinued P290 in the Discovery Sport range. Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 Engine Codes AJ200P A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the Discovery Sport P250 from 2019 to the present. No specific known issue has been independently confirmed for this application. codes.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport P250 ENGINE

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the Discovery Sport P250 from 2023 to present. The AJ200P features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ200P V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ200P rebuild.
